demo.title: Book a Live Demo
demo.body: Tell us about your calls, routing, calendars, and CRM. We will tailor the demonstration to your workflow.

pricing.title: Request Pricing
pricing.body: Tell us about volume, workflows, languages, integrations, and support requirements. Codestra will prepare a scoped estimate.

thanks.title: Thank You
thanks.body: Your request has been accepted for mock delivery. A production follow-up begins only after the approved Odoo adapter is activated.

security.title: Controlled by Your Business Rules
security.body: The service boundary supports encrypted connections, restricted actions, rate limiting, bot protection, secret management, audit history, consent controls, retention configuration, and human escalation. Certifications are not claimed.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: Product terms, recording consent, data retention, service levels, and integration scope are confirmed in the applicable signed agreement. Contact Codestra for the current approved terms.
